name: vscode-scalim
description: YAML DSL schema + LSP integration for scalim

scalim.yamlDsl.envMode.description: Server environment mode. workspaceVenv: reuse an existing workspace venv. path: use scalim-yaml-dsl-lsp from PATH. auto: try workspaceVenv first (if valid), then try PATH. pinnedVenv: manage an isolated pinned venv under globalStorageUri (requires explicit user action to install).

scalim.yamlDsl.workspaceVenvPath.description: Path to the workspace virtual environment (used when envMode=workspaceVenv/auto). Can be absolute or relative to the workspace folder.

scalim.yamlDsl.pythonPath.description: Path to python (>=3.10) used to provision the LSP server venv. Leave empty to auto-detect.

scalim.yamlDsl.pinnedServerSpec.description: Pinned pip requirement used to provision the YAML DSL LSP server.

scalim.yamlDsl.autoSchemaBinding.description: Offer to update workspace yaml.schemas mapping (requires redhat.vscode-yaml). Always asks for confirmation before writing workspace settings.

scalim.yamlDsl.autoRestartOnScalimYamlCh.description: Automatically restart the LSP server when scalim.yaml is created/changed/deleted. When false, the extension will prompt you.

scalim.yamlDsl.serverDebounceMs.description: Debounce (ms) for diagnostics/effective-view recomputation after typing. Lower = faster updates but more CPU/typing lag.

scalim.yamlDsl.autoRestartOnSettingsChan.description: Automatically restart the LSP server when certain scalim.yamlDsl settings change (e.g. serverDebounceMs).

scalim.yamlDsl.serverLogLevel.description: Server log verbosity written to server.log (passed as --log-level).

scalim.yamlDsl.lspTrace.description: LSP wire trace (client-side). WARNING: this can include full YAML contents from didOpen/didChange, so keep it off unless you're debugging.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
